category: hosted bot (torrent or magnet to Telegram file)

free_tier.stated: Free to use: 'A powerful Torrent Leech Bot! With Permanent Thumbnail Support'. The operator's channel advertises 'Free to use: Support for files up to 4GB in size.'
free_tier.notes: 4 GB exceeds the 2 GB free-account object ceiling, which implies the operator uploads through Premium or a user session; that is inference

per_object_cap.stated: 'Support for files up to 4GB in size' on the operator's channel; Telegram's free-account ceiling is 2 GB.
per_object_cap.notes: 4 GB is the operator's claim; no byte-exact figure and no per-day quota

retention.stated: The leeched file is delivered into the requesting chat and follows cloud-chat retention; the operator states no storage window.

egress.terms: Free; the operator pulls the torrent and uploads the result to Telegram, so the client's own bandwidth is only the download.

interface_detail: A Telegram chat: send a magnet or .torrent, pick files, receive them as Telegram documents.
tooling: Any Telegram client. Two handles exist for the same bot (@maxxleech_bot and @MaxxLeech_Bot) and both resolve.
chaining: Turns a magnet into a Telegram object without the client running a BitTorrent client or a seedbox; the 4 GB claim is the only public statement that a hosted bot beats Telegram's free 2 GB ceiling.

limits.value: 'up to 4GB in size' claimed by the operator

binding_note: If the 4 GB claim holds it is the loosest object cap found on a free hosted bot. No volume figure is published, so no other kind can be named.

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account; the bot asks for no key.

reliability_note: A single-operator leech service; the channel already announces that 'Search result files will now be automatically deleted after 1 day', so delivered files can be transient.
confidence_note: A measured 3-4 GB leech would move it to measured.

evidence.proved: 'A powerful Torrent Leech Bot! With Permanent Thumbnail Support' and 'Bot By: @MaxxBots'
channel post: 'Free to use: Support for files up to 4GB in size.' and 'Search result files will now be automatically deleted after 1 day.'

notes: Abandon if the 4 GB line disappears from the channel. The 4 GB claim is the single most interesting number in this class and the one most worth measuring.
